column1: # A held-out corpus: 400 random PubChem molecules, `group name SMILES`.
# Drawn from a 200k random PubChem sample under seed 20260928 -- a seed used
# for nothing else -- keeping single-fragment molecules of 10 to 120 heavy
# atoms that RDKit's MMFF94 can type, and explicitly disjoint from every
# scratch corpora used while tuning (6855 molecules in all).
# It exists to answer one question: do the embedder's numbers hold on
# molecules that no decision was made against? It was spent once, on
# 2026-09-28, for the comparison in NEXT.md ("What the numbers are worth").
# **Tuning against it spends it again and it stops being held out.** Draw a
# fresh one with a new seed instead; the recipe above is the whole of it.
